tagline: Zeiss Ikon盒式相机，1934 年发布
description: Zeiss Ikon于1934年推出的盒式相机。配备size 4.5x6 cm models have a Goerz Frontar 11/9cm lens.size 6x9 cm models have a Goerz Frontar 11/11.5cm lens.。快门速度Zeiss Ikon "Spezial". T and I (1/25sec).。

specs.镜头: size 4.5x6 cm models have a Goerz Frontar 11/9cm lens.size 6x9 cm models have a Goerz Frontar 11/11.5cm lens.
specs.尺寸: size 4.5x6 cm models 93 x 88 x 75 mm.size 6x9 cm models 115 x 105 x 74 mm.
specs.重量: size 4.5x6 cm models c.370 grams.size 6x9 cm models c.525 grams.
specs.英文简介: The Baldur (854/16) is a Box camera made by Zeiss Ikon from 1934 onwards.
